definitions.explanation: An area of land that is lower than the surrounding terrain, often near rivers or the coast. Prone to flooding. The opposite of 高地 (highland). Composed of 低 (low) + 地 (ground).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低地|ていち}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まり→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This area is low-lying, so water tends to accumulate.

examples.japanese: {低地|ていち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Living in a low-lying area means a high risk of flooding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{低地|ていち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}→避難勧告：16642_hinankankoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出|で}された。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, an evacuation advisory was issued for residents of low-lying areas.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly appears in weather reports and disaster preparedness information. Japan has many {低地|ていち} areas along rivers and coastlines that are vulnerable to flooding during typhoons and heavy rains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低地|ていち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧ (flooding of low-lying areas)
- ⟦{沿岸|えんがん}→沿岸：13280_engan⟧{低地|ていち} (coastal lowland)
- ⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧{低地|ていち} (river lowland)
- {低地|ていち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in a low-lying area)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{高地|こうち}→高地：29340_kouchi⟧ (highland) is the antonym. ⟦{平地|へいち}→平地：19229_heichi⟧ (flat land) refers to level terrain regardless of elevation.
